independent_statistical_unit: environment; model seeds, prefixes, actions, horizons and fingers are nested repeated observations

definitions.persistence: Current tactile and height held constant; previous measured interval peak held constant.
definitions.normal_force_persistence: Same, except peak forecast holds current endpoint normal force constant.
definitions.action_effect: Predicted and actual candidate-minus-center differences, center index4 excluded from the averaged error; all5horizons retained.
definitions.rank: Spearman correlation with exact midranks for ties; constant rankings are undefined, reported with defined fraction.
definitions.selection: Among predicted peak<=8N candidates maximize clipped terminal height/0.10; exactties choosecenter thenindex. Ifnone predictedfeasible chooseminimum predictedpeak.
definitions.regret: Oracle minus selected executed utility over9branches; utility=clip(terminalheight/.10,0,1) if all branchsubsteps peak<=8N else0. Prefix forces are excluded from this local diagnostic.
definitions.paired_difference: Model metric minus each named persistence baseline within each environment, then bootstrap whole environments. Both previous-interval-peak and current-endpoint-normal baselines are retained.
definitions.branching: Everybranch independently reset and replayed; no partial-state restoration.

limitations: Local five-step decisions do not measure sustained lifting or closed-loop safety.
Diagnostic prefix policy uses common privileged scripted approach/vertical reference; learned model sees only RGB,tactile,proprio.
Vision raw forecasts exclude tactile input; vision anchored forecasts additionally use the identical measured-tactile offset correction, so they are not vision-only predictions.
Averaging over fixed clipping duplicates is retained by protocol; unique candidate counts are reported.
Rank means are conditional on defined rankings; see defined fractions.
Diagnostic outcomes must not tune model weights, gains, or choose primary evaluation cohorts.
